data.name: SIM_EXTRAPOLATION_TOOLTIP
data.value:
If the source temperature falls below the lowest data point of the heat pump characteristic curve, the curve is extended linearly.
With the tick (default): extrapolation takes place and the run records this as a note. This corresponds exactly to the previous behaviour - up to package 8 the engine asked at this point.
Without the tick: the simulation aborts and names the affected unit. Useful if extrapolated characteristic values should not enter a result; the curve then has to be supplemented with lower data points.

data.name: SIM_KASKADE_TOOLTIP
data.value:
Calculates space heating and domestic hot water demand as separate channels and separates the storage charging from the generator cascade.
This CHANGES the results: units with a buffer storage as sink charge it instead of covering the demand directly; the demand is covered from the storage. What changes in detail is described in the implementation log for package 4 (part 7, Documented result changes). Without the tick, the previous single-channel cascade continues to calculate unchanged.
The tick is set automatically as soon as the configuration handles domestic hot water and space heating separately - the single-channel path would then be blind to DHW/combi storage sinks and source references.

data.value:
Cascade (boiler): the boiler draws its inlet temperature from the selected buffer storage instead of from the system return.
Share = (storage flow − boiler return) / (boiler flow − boiler return)
The fuel demand drops by this share of the useful heat; the withdrawal is at the same time a discharge of the storage. If the storage delivers less, fuel covers the shortfall. The boiler is computed after the generator that charges the storage.
